title: How Much Higher Can Japanese Stocks Go?
summary: Elizaveta Gridneva of IBKR Hong Kong welcomes Nick Ng back to the IBKR podcast to discuss all things Japanese markets. From rising bond yields and yen intervention to Japan’s equity rally, corporate governance reforms, and the forces shaping its long-term outlook, Nick breaks down what investors should be watching.
